title: Nock's Sandcastle | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful NatureWalk Home:  * 4 Bikes Included* 2 King Master Suites w/ ensuite bathrooms* Heated Outdoor Shower and Private Lawn Area* Quiet Neighborhood, surrounded by bike and walking trails* Access to "Gathering Place" with Pools
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful NatureWalk Home: * 4 Bikes Included* 2 King Master Suites w/ ensuite bathrooms* Heated Outdoor Shower and Private Lawn Area* Quiet Neighborhood, surrounded by bike and walking trails* Access to "Gathering Place" with Pools, Hammocks, Grills, and Fire Pit * Walking or Biking Distance to Fabulous Shopping and Dining Options* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 ServiceWelcome to Nock's Sandcastle, the perfect 30A vacation destination! This beautiful home, located inside the quiet NatureWalk 30A Resort Community, offers 4 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, and will sleep up to 9 guests comfortably. Step through the doors to find designer finishes, beautiful wood flooring, and outdoor shower to enhance your stay! The first floor offers an open living room with a flat-screen television, a dining area that seats 8, and a fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances, marble countertops, and bar seating for 4. Additionally, on the first floor, you will find a Master suite with a King bed and an ensuite bathroom. The second floor offers a second Master suite with a King bed, a guest bedroom with two Twin beds, and a bunk room with a Twin-over-Full bunk bed. Come enjoy this lovely new home for your relaxing beach vacation! *This property is not available to adults Under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* *Guests will be charged $150 for a lost or missing amenity pass and $150 for a lost golf cart key. Please leave the amenity pass and the key in the home upon departure.*Garage is not for guest use at this home.**Due to an HOA restriction boats, RVs and trailers are not allowed in this neighborhood*The Bed Setup1st Floor:Master Suite: King Bed2nd Floor:Master Suite: King BedGuest Bedroom: Two Twin BedsBunk Room: Twin-over-Full bunk bed NatureWalk 30A is ideally located on Hwy 395 off of 30A, next to Watercolor and Seaside. NatureWalk is surrounded by Point Washington State Forest, and Grayton Beach State Park and Western Lake are located right next to Watercolor. Explore the endless trails by bike or on foot. Rent a canoe or paddleboard. Visit the funky shops and restaurants in Grayton Beach town, just down 30A. Watercolor Crossings adjoins our neighborhood, with Publix, Pizza by the Sea, Boca Boutique, UPS Store, Emerald Coast Wine and Spirits, Perfect Pig restaurant, Pedego Electric Bikes, and Yellowfin Sports, for all your outdoor needs. Due to HOA restriction boats, RVs and trailers are not allowed in this neighborhood.NatureWalk 30A has a private path “Lilly Lane Beach Trail” to San Juan Avenue which is less than a mile from beach access at Santa Clara Regional Beach Access. This path goes through the beautiful state forest which also surrounds NatureWalk 30A. Several additional beach accesses are also located along 30A within a mile. The beaches at Seaside or Watercolor, as well as Grayton Beach State Park are a short bike ride away.NatureWalk features “Gathering Place” which boasts a large zero-entry pool, a heated lap pool, hot tub, lounge chairs, tables and chairs, a shaded kiddie pool, hammocks, a playground, outdoor kitchen with gas grills, and gas fire pit for family enjoyment. You will also volleyball courts, pickleball, basketball, and another playground nearby. Guests will be charged $150 for lost or missing amenity pass. Please leave the amenity pass in the home upon departure.Area Attractions:30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis - you'll find it all right here.WaterColor, Florida is a beach town with rich landscaping and incredible pocket parks that blend perfectly into Northwest Florida’s natural scrub oak and palmetto. WaterColor borders the Gulf of Mexico and Western Lake, South Walton’s largest coastal dune lake. Great care was taken to preserve the natural beauty of Western Lake. Gravel nature trails twist and wind through the oak scrub and foot bridges criss-cross Western Lake. On the North side of Scenic 30-A, you will find a large butterfly garden that leads to an outdoor amphitheater and boathouse. At the boathouse, try stand up paddle-boarding, kayaking, or canoeing over towards the shores of Grayton Beach State Park. On the South side of Scenic 30-A is the WaterColor Beach Club and along with the home of the James Beard award-winning restaurant, Fish Out of Water. Community access to the Gulf of Mexico is through a beach boardwalk adjacent to the Beach Club. WaterColor Florida is a fabulous spot for your next beach vacation!Seaside is a fantastic destination within walking distance and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous, There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
